versions.name: Tesomas Scout Camp

features.note: An ATV riding course leading to rider certification, for older Scouts.
Shower buildings on each side of camp.
Eagle Quest, a first-year camper advancement programme.
Micro-Trek tracks for campers who have already done much of the standard programme.
Swimming is in spring-fed Crystal Lake; there is no pool.
A night zip line runs at the COPE and climbing area.

versions.summary: Samoset Council's flagship Scouts BSA resident camp at Crystal Lake Scout Reservation near Rhinelander, Wisconsin, offering week-long periods with a wide range of merit badge opportunities.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
